### Build It Right
Author: Jim Liebelt
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/build-it-right-homeword-july-5.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 3:11-14
Points:
- Jesus Christ serves as the only true foundation for a believer's life.
- Daily choices determine our building materials, whether virtues like love and forgiveness or inferior attitudes.
- The manner and motivation of our workmanship matter just as much as external appearances.
- A day of testing will reveal the true quality of how each person has built.
- Believers are urged to live intentionally for God's glory so their work endures.
